rate_model_note: One toll station on the Saint Lawrence crossing, charged in both directions; a per-axle rate by vehicle category. The grid prints the same amount for every period (weekday peaks, weekends, holidays), so one rate at all hours.
valid_to_note: The operator's fee page says the grid applies through this date; the Gazette grid itself says it stands until a new one is published. Passages after it are still priced from this card until a newer one is added - check for the new grid.
reprices_on: annually, about 1 February (Gazette officielle du Québec)
source_note: 'GRILLE TARIFAIRE ... en vigueur à compter du 28 février 2026'. Catégorie B (under 230 cm, not oversize) = 2.20 $ per axle in every period; 2_axle is DERIVED as 2 x 2.20. Cross-checked against https://a30express.com/en/fees-categories/toll-fees-payment ('$2.20/axle', 'a regular passenger vehicle will pay $4.40 per crossing').
payment_premium_note: No plate premium: the booth takes credit and debit cards (not cash) at the same rate as the transponder. A vehicle that passes without paying owes 8.00 $ recovery fee per passage on top (37.00 $ after a further 7 days) - not estimated.
